walkthrough: The dust heaps show where air in the stationary wave hardly moves - the displacement nodes. The diagram marks $30\text{ cm}$ between the first and fourth heap shown.
Between four heaps there are three node-to-node gaps. Each node-to-node distance is half a wavelength, $\lambda/2$.
The full wavelength is $\lambda = 2 \times 0.10\text{ m} = 0.20\text{ m}$.
For the sound wave, $v = f\lambda$, so $f = v/\lambda = 330/0.20 = 1650\text{ Hz}$ with unit $\text{Hz}$.
